items.evidence: Log lines 2-127 show 106/40/4/2 µL master mix, 19 µL per well A1:G1, 2.5 µL fwd/rev primers A1..G1/A2..G2 paired to the matching wells, and 1 µL templates from A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1, then 3x15 µL mixes.

Log lines 186-288 add 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart and 1 µL DpnI to A1:G1 and mix 3x30 µL. The 37/65 °C incubation and Zymo cleanup are recorded in order with protocol.comment, with protocol.pause calls.
Log lines 290-428 add 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, 3 µL frag2, 2 µL frag5, 3 µL frag6, 2 µL frag 1/3/4/7 to A1:D1, and 1 µL enzyme mix with 5x mix, giving 20 µL.

The Golden Gate program (30x 37/16 °C, 60 °C), the cleanup and the heat shock are recorded in comments with the specified parameters. The log then shows 5 µL assembly to cells_plate A1:D1 (lines 430-443) and 250 µL LB to each well (446-453).

The log shows a fresh p20 tip for each primer, template, fragment and enzyme transfer and per-well mixes. Only shared-reagent distributions (master mix, water, buffers, LB) reuse one tip, as in the reference, and the run ends with no tip held.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and its pipetting matches the specified volumes, wells and order for PCR, DpnI, assembly and transformation. Off-deck steps are recorded as comments and the tip handling avoids cross-contamination.
